Updated `continual-arc/SKILL.md` to serve as the entry point and link to four focused procedure files: translated motif copies, separator-tile classification, periodic diagonal fill, and missing edge continuation. This keeps the main workflow concise while preserving each branch’s specific safeguards and demo checks. No procedure was retired; the available evidence did not establish any as redundant or obsolete.

Read the revised skill and all four supporting files, then listed the skill directory to confirm the referenced files are present. The retained workflow still requires validating changes against demonstrations and choosing a legal action. No unresolved or unreviewed skill scope remains in this directory.
